fixes.explanation: Caesar's! Jesus asks whose image and inscription are on the coin, and they answer, “Caesar’s.” Now the men who came with all the questions are the ones answering, and they're the ones who brought Him the coin (Matthew 22:19). That's like walking into a meeting to grill somebody and ending up presenting the slides. Their own answer sets up what Jesus says next.

Nope, that's False, friend. The text says, “…when they heard this, they were amazed.” Then they left Him and went away. They showed up with a trap all planned, like somebody carrying a full presentation into a meeting and leaving without ever opening the laptop. I bet that walk away was a quiet one.
